Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom. OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the Opportunity

As OKX scales its business across the Americas and continues to navigate an increasingly complex tax and regulatory landscape, we are looking for an Americas Tax Manager / Senior Manager to join our lean, high-impact tax team, partnering closely with Business, Product, Finance, Legal, Compliance and other stakeholders across the region. The role will focus on providing commercially practical tax advice, supporting business growth and managing tax risks across the United States, Brazil, Argentina, El Salvador.

What You’ll Be Doing

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to the following:

  • Act as the primary tax business partner for the Americas region, building strong relationships with Business, Product, Finance, Legal, Compliance and Operations teams across the region;
  • Work/ advise on corporate direct and indirect tax compliance, filings, payments, tax calendars, and related statutory requirements across the United States, Brazil, Argentina, El Salvador including US federal, state and local tax matters;
  • Lead regional tax provision and reporting, including current and deferred tax calculations, effective tax rate items, reconciliations, quarterly and annual audit support.
  • Work closely with other members of the tax team i.e. transfer pricing, indirect tax as well as local finance teams, external advisors on tax advisory, compliance matters;
  • Monitor changes and updates in tax legislation across the Americas to identify potential tax impacts and mitigation strategies and support tax controversy matters etc;
  • Maintain documentation of key regional tax positions, tax risks and decisions, and develop standing audit files for material matters;
  • Contribute to process improvement initiatives, including the implementation of practical tax review gates, enhancement of documentation standards and improvement of regional tax risk monitoring;
  • Build strong relationships with non-tax stakeholders and proactively share relevant tax insights and information to encourage early engagement;
  • Any other tasks and projects assigned.

What We Look For In You

  • 10+ years of experience, ideally with a mix of Big 4 / advisory and in-house roles;
  • Strong knowledge of US corporate and international tax concepts, with familiarity with US state and local tax matters. Experience supporting one or more Latin American jurisdictions is highly preferred;
  • Broad understanding of international tax concepts, including permanent establishment and nexus, withholding tax, transfer pricing and indirect tax as well as Pillar 2, CbCR required;
  • Proven business partnering experience, with the ability to understand commercial objectives, explain complex tax issues clearly and provide practical, balanced recommendations;
  • Strong analytical skills with keen attention to both detail and the bigger picture, and the ability to manage multiple workstreams across different jurisdictions and time zones;
  • Self-starter, comfortable operating with ambiguity in a fast-paced, start-up-like environment; resourceful, adaptable and collaborative;
  • Experience in digital assets, fintech, financial services or another highly regulated technology business is a plus;
  • Familiarity with tax technology, data analytics or AI applications in tax processes is a plus.

About Bitdeer:

Bitdeer is a world-leading technology company for AI and Bitcoin mining infrastructure.

Bitdeer is committed to providing comprehensive Bitcoin mining solutions for its customers and building AI computational infrastructure to support the AI revolution. Bitdeer handles complex processes involved in computing such as equipment procurement, transport logistics, data center design and construction, equipment management, and daily operations. Bitdeer also offers advanced cloud capabilities to customers with high demand for artificial intelligence.

Headquartered in Singapore, Bitdeer has deployed data centers across multiple countries, including the United States, Norway, Bhutan, and Ethiopia. To learn more, visit https://ir.bitdeer.com/

We are seeking

We are seeking a Director, Utility Interconnection & Power Development to secure and accelerate power for Bitdeer’s AI data center and Bitcoin mining sites in ERCOT and other US markets. As part of the Global Powered Land Infrastructure (GPLI) team, you will be Bitdeer’s lead interface with utilities and ERCOT, taking large-load requests from first application through studies, agreements, and energization.

You will build and manage Bitdeer’s power and interconnection pipeline, assess power availability for new and expansion sites, and develop power ramp plans that keep pace with our construction schedules. The ideal candidate brings deep utility-side or developer-side experience with large-load interconnection in Texas, a strong engineering foundation, and the commercial judgment to negotiate utility agreements that protect Bitdeer’s timelines and costs.

What you will be responsible for

Utility Interconnection

  • Large-Load Requests: Lead large-load interconnection and transmission-service requests with Oncor and other Texas utilities, and with utilities in other US markets as needed.
  • ERCOT Processes: Guide sites through ERCOT large-load interconnection processes (e.g., Batch Zero and Batch 1+ studies), including load studies, data submittals, and follow-up requests.
  • Utility Agreements: Negotiate and manage utility service, interconnection, and commercial agreements (e.g., Facilities Extension Agreements, Discretionary Service Agreements, and generation interconnection agreements).

Power Development

  • Site Power Assessment: Assess power availability, required upgrades, costs, and timelines for new and expansion sites, and recommend site priorities and sequencing to leadership.
  • Interconnection Pipeline: Build and manage Bitdeer’s power and interconnection pipeline across all sites, from early utility engagement through energization.
  • Power Ramp Planning: Develop staged power ramp and energization plans that match data center build and deployment schedules.
  • Co-Located & Bridge Power: Support evaluation of co-located generation, battery storage, and other bridge-power options where grid capacity is delayed, in partnership with the Power Strategy team.

Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Construction Alignment: Work with electrical/HV construction, design, and commissioning teams so substation, transmission, and interconnection milestones align with construction schedules.
  • Power Strategy Partnership: Partner with the Power Strategy team on energy procurement, market strategy, and load flexibility.
  • Commercial & Legal Support: Coordinate with legal and finance on agreement terms, contributions in aid of construction (CIAC), and utility financial security requirements.

Regulatory, Relationships & Reporting

  • Regulatory Monitoring: Track PUCT, ERCOT, and utility rule changes that affect large loads and assess their impact on Bitdeer’s sites and plans.
  • Utility Relationships: Build and maintain strong relationships with utility account, planning, and engineering teams.
  • Pipeline Reporting: Maintain the interconnection tracker and report status, risks, and timelines to leadership.

How you will stand out

  • Experience: 10+ years in utility or power infrastructure roles, including large-load interconnection experience in ERCOT.
  • Interconnection Expertise: Hands-on experience managing large-load interconnection and transmission-service requests for data center, crypto mining, or large industrial customers.
  • Utility Agreements: Experience developing or negotiating utility service, facilities extension, and interconnection agreements.
  • Technical Foundation: Strong understanding of transmission planning, substations, system protection, and load studies.
  • Texas Market Knowledge: Working knowledge of ERCOT, PUCT rules, and Texas utility processes.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field; Master’s degree or MBA preferred.
  • Certifications: Professional Engineer (PE) license preferred; PMP or Certified Energy Manager (CEM) a plus.
  • Bridge Power Experience: Experience evaluating co-located generation, battery storage, or other bridge-power options for large loads.
  • Relationship Building: Builds trusted, long-term relationships with utilities and regulators.
  • Commercial Judgment: Balances cost, schedule, and risk when negotiating utility terms.
  • Cross-Functional Coordination: Aligns engineering, construction, legal, finance, and external partners around one plan.
  • Clear Communication: Explains complex utility and regulatory topics simply to executives and project teams.

What you will experience working with us

  • A culture that values authenticity and diverse perspectives.
  • An inclusive, respectful environment with open workspaces and an energetic, start-up spirit.
  • A fast-growing company with opportunities to network with industry pioneers and enthusiasts.
  • The ability to contribute directly and make an impact on the future of the digital asset and AI computing industry.
  • Involvement in new projects and in developing processes/systems.
  • Personal accountability, autonomy, rapid growth, and learning opportunities.
  • Attractive benefits and development such as training and mentoring.

Program ownership and governance

  • Update, implement, and maintain a risk-based BSA/AML/CFT and OFAC program covering the five pillars: internal controls, independent testing, a designated BSA Officer, training, and customer due diligence including beneficial ownership.

Travel Rule and sanctions

The Opportunity

This is an opportunity to work on the engineering behind a live exchange where speed, reliability and accuracy matter.

You will take ownership of and improve the systems responsible for processing orders, matching trades and supporting exchange operations: operating them in production, making them faster and extending them safely.

Overview

We are looking for someone who understands more than just writing code. You should understand how trading systems work, how to build them reliably at scale and how to solve the technical challenges that come with real-time transactions.

You will have meaningful ownership of technical decisions, shape the platform's architecture and work closely with the wider team to turn product requirements into reliable, production-ready systems.

Responsibilities

  • Take ownership of the Busha Pro exchange: learn the codebase deeply, operate it in production and harden it.
  • Design, build and optimize the backend systems that power Busha Pro’s trading capabilities.
  • Develop and improve matching engine components, order books, order processing and trade execution workflows. Keep matching deterministic and consistent under peak load, with no crossed books, ghost fills or stale order state.
  • Build reliable systems that can handle high transaction volumes while maintaining speed, accuracy and consistency.
  • Work on APIs (REST, WebSocket, and later FIX), real-time market data, event-driven services and integrations that connect different parts of the trading platform.
  • Improve system performance, reduce latency and identify bottlenecks before they become production issues. Benchmark and profile the matching path, load-test against realistic traffic and measure every change against a baseline.
  • Build safeguards that help maintain accurate order processing, transaction integrity and reliable system recovery: pre-trade risk checks, price bands, circuit breakers, kill switches, failover and disaster recovery.
  • Keep the ledger exact: trades and fees settled atomically, real-time balances, and crypto and fiat deposits and withdrawals reconciled against custody and banking records.
  • Add trading pairs, order types (such as OCO, take-profit and stop-loss) and features, released with zero downtime.
  • Analyze business product requirements and propose effective technical solutions.
  • Write clean, testable and maintainable code, and participate in code reviews and technical design discussions. Test matching and ledger invariants with simulation and replay.
  • Take ownership of features from design and implementation through testing, deployment and ongoing monitoring.
  • Share the on-call rotation for production trading systems.
  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering and DevOps to deliver key technical priorities.
  • Share your knowledge, support other engineers and contribute to strong engineering practices.

What We're Looking For

  • 5–7+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong backend development experience.
  • Strong in Go, or strong in Rust, C++ or Java and willing to work primarily in Go.
  • Hands-on experience building, operating or improving trading systems, exchange infrastructure, matching engines or comparable real-time transaction-processing platforms.
  • A solid understanding of order books, order lifecycles, matching logic and trade execution.
  • Experience building systems where performance, concurrency, reliability and data consistency are critical, including idempotency, exactly-once processing and recovery from partial failures.
  • Experience working on systems that require low latency, high availability and predictable execution under heavy load.
  • Strong knowledge of data structures, algorithms, databases and distributed systems.
  • Experience designing APIs, event-driven services and scalable backend architectures.
  • Good judgment in an existing codebase: you improve a live system in small, safe steps rather than reaching for a rewrite.
  • Performance work grounded in measurement: profiling, latency percentiles (p99 and above), and memory and garbage-collection tuning.
  • Working knowledge of Linux internals (threading, CPU and NUMA effects, system calls) and TCP/UDP networking.
  • A practical approach to testing, debugging, performance optimisation and production reliability, including testing that proves correctness through simulation, fuzzing or replaying production traffic.
  • You've run what you built in production, including on-call and incident response, and can debug across the OS, network and application layers.
  • The ability to take ownership of complex technical work and deliver it with minimal supervision.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to communicate technical decisions clearly.

Requirements

  • Experience at a cryptocurrency exchange, financial trading platform or electronic market.
  • Familiarity with risk controls, settlement or market data infrastructure.
  • Crypto infrastructure: wallets, custody, blockchain nodes, deposit and withdrawal pipelines.
  • Fiat payment rails: bank transfers, local payment networks, settlement and reconciliation.
  • The FIX protocol, event sourcing, or low-latency patterns such as the LMAX Disruptor.
  • Experience with market surveillance, regulatory reporting or audits at a regulated venue.
  • TypeScript/Node.js for services, gateways or internal tools around the engine.

What Success Looks Like

You'll help us build trading systems that are reliable, performant and ready to scale. You'll take ownership of important engineering deliverables, improve the quality of our infrastructure and help ensure that orders and trades are processed accurately and efficiently.

We value engineers who are proactive, thoughtful in their technical decisions and comfortable taking responsibility for the systems they build.

Why Join Busha?

At Busha, you'll have the opportunity to work on challenging financial technology, influence important engineering decisions and help shape the infrastructure behind Busha Pro.

If you enjoy solving complex backend problems, building performance-sensitive systems and working on technology where reliability and precision genuinely matter, we'd love to hear from you.

About Flowdesk

At Flowdesk, we are building the infrastructure powering the next era of global finance. As a full-service digital asset trading and technology firm, we provide liquidity solutions, OTC trading, and market infrastructure that connect digital assets to global markets with institutional-grade precision, transparency, and scale. Flowdesk combines expertise from traditional finance, algorithmic trading, and blockchain technology to deliver always-on trading capabilities across the digital asset ecosystem.

Founded in 2020, we have grown into a global team supporting institutions, exchanges, and token issuers worldwide as the financial system evolves toward tokenized markets.

Why join Flowdesk? You'll be joining a company operating at the intersection of finance, technology, and crypto - solving complex market problems, building critical infrastructure, and helping shape how digital assets move globally. We move fast, think long term, and work with a strong ownership mindset across engineering, trading, product, operations, and business teams.

Role Description

Our OTC Tech team builds and maintains the systems behind our OTC derivatives trading, working directly with traders and quants. The team is small, so engineers have wide ownership and a direct line to the people using what they build.

We are looking for a hands-on Rust engineer with options trading or financial engineering exposure to join the team. Parts of our OTC derivatives stack are quant-heavy, and some libraries are difficult to change safely without deeper domain knowledge. You will be the person who can work confidently in that code. The role remains primarily engineering, not research.

  • Build, maintain and extend OTC derivatives trading systems in Rust
  • Implement and modify pricing, risk and quoting logic designed by our quant and research teams, translating models into reliable production code
  • Take ownership of quant-heavy libraries that are currently hard to change, and make them safer to evolve
  • Work closely with traders to turn requirements into shipped features
  • Own features end to end, from pricing logic through to the trader-facing tools, including some front-end work in Typescript

Requirements

Must Have

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience in a comparable role, with the ability to work autonomously
  • Strong Rust - the primary language for this role
  • Hands-on experience building or supporting options or derivatives systems, such as pricing, risk, quoting or trade booking, at a bank, trading firm or market maker
  • Quantitative grounding: enough to read, understand and implement pricing and risk models (you will not be expected to design or price derivatives from scratch)
  • Experience building production systems in a trading or other high-stakes environment
  • Able to work directly with traders: turn their requests into clear requirements, explain technical trade-offs simply, and keep them informed when something goes wrong

Preferred

  • Experience at an OTC derivatives desk, options market maker, or institutional crypto trading firm
  • Experience with pricing libraries, volatility surfaces, Greeks, or risk systems
  • Experience beyond backend work, such as front-end, internal tooling or data pipelines
  • Startup or small-team experience with end-to-end ownership and a fast delivery pace
  • C++ background - useful where Rust experience is being built

Location

  • Singapore

Person Profile

  • Independent and resourceful
  • Team player and collaborative
  • Curious, humble, always learning
  • Strong maths and analytical skills
  • Ability to successfully manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced collaborative environment
  • Professional proficiency in English

Company Culture & Values

  • Take Action & Own the Mission
  • Be of Service & Contribute
  • Innovate, Create Value, & Be Courageous
  • Act with Integrity & Respect

Benefits

  • International environment (English is the main language)
  • Team events and offsites
  • Company Pension scheme
  • Learning and Development budget

Recruitment Process

Our process is consistent across all engineering roles and is designed to assess genuine technical depth. Candidates should expect the following stages:

  • Stage 1: First round interview with a member of our Talent Acquisition team (45 mins)
  • Stage 2: Online technical test
  • Stage 3: Engineering interview with the hiring manager - technical experience and software engineering fundamentals
  • Stage 4: On-site Interview
  • Stage 5: Round-Up meeting with Head of Talent Strategy

About Open Standard

Open Standard is building internet-native money.

We believe that much like data moved to the cloud, dollars will move on-chain. As this transition occurs, stablecoins will become core financial infrastructure. To do that, we are building Open USD (https://ousd.xyz/). OUSD is live across Base, Ethereum, Solana, and Tempo, with Coinbase, Mastercard, Shopify, Stripe, and Visa as founding partners.

We are still very early, and the engineers joining now will shape both the product and the company.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Smart Contract Engineer to help build the on-chain and off-chain infrastructure behind Open USD.

You’ll work across smart contracts, protocol design, blockchain infrastructure, indexing, monitoring, and the systems that turn on-chain activity into reliable products.

This is not a role where you only write contracts. We care deeply about how protocols work in production: how events are indexed, how state is reconstructed, how off-chain systems respond to on-chain activity, and how we make the overall system reliable and usable at scale.

You’ll have significant ownership over architecture, implementation, security, and the technical foundations of Open Standard.

What You'll Do

  • Design and build smart contracts supporting OUSD across multiple blockchains.

  • Build infrastructure around minting, burning, transfers, rewards, and other protocol functionality.

  • Design indexing and event-driven systems that reliably turn on-chain activity into usable off-chain state.

  • Build monitoring and alerting systems for critical protocol events and anomalous behavior.

  • Design systems that can handle reorgs, duplicate events, delayed events, and other realities of blockchain infrastructure.

  • Work across on-chain and off-chain systems rather than treating smart contracts in isolation.

  • Own projects from technical design through deployment, monitoring, and iteration.

  • Work closely with the founding team and external partners on protocol integrations.

  • Contribute to security reviews, testing, and overall protocol architecture.

Who You Are

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, with meaningful experience building blockchain systems.

  • Strong experience with Solidity and EVM-based smart contracts, or equivalent experience on other major chains.

  • Strong understanding of blockchain architecture, transaction lifecycle, cryptographic principles, and smart contract security.

  • Experience building and operating production smart contracts.

  • Experience with indexing blockchain data and building off-chain systems around on-chain protocols.

  • Strong understanding of event-driven architecture and event sourcing, including how to reconstruct and reconcile state from blockchain events.

  • Comfortable reasoning about reorgs, idempotency, eventual consistency, retries, and failure modes across on-chain and off-chain systems.

  • Strong ownership and the ability to independently drive technical decisions.

  • Able to move quickly while maintaining a very high bar for correctness and security.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with stablecoins, DeFi, payments, trading, or financial infrastructure.

  • Experience across multiple chains, especially Ethereum/EVM and Solana.

  • Experience building indexers, data pipelines, or blockchain data infrastructure.

  • Experience with protocol monitoring, reconciliation, and production incident response.

  • Experience building developer-facing APIs or infrastructure.

  • Experience working on highly secure or financially sensitive systems.

We’re looking for someone who thinks beyond the smart contract itself. The best protocol engineers understand that what happens off-chain can be just as important as what happens on-chain.
